title: Mercury
description: Calm ink-blue dark: one near-black page with a violet tint, cards a single step lighter, soft off-white text, and one periwinkle blue for pill CTAs. Hairline rules mark sections; pale frosted art panels carry the colour. A soft wide grotesk at light-medium weights. Light sibling: cool off-white page, white cards, ink text.
notes: Hanken Grotesk stands in for Mercury's own (closed) Arcadia; set at in-between weights (360, 420, 480)
chart-1…5 are the art palette: periwinkle, dusk rose, mist blue, moss, warm paper
